name: SharedWorker
plain: A background script that all tabs of a site share, so one process keeps state across them.
meaning: Lets a site keep one connection and a single cross-tab state, which also shows how many tabs the person has. Partitioned like other storage in modern browsers, so a tracker cannot join sites with it.

access.persistence: While at least one connected page is alive
access.revocation: Clear site data, browser privacy settings

limits.headline: Can run one background script shared by all open tabs of the site
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens while you have the site open in more than one tab.
can: Keep one connection or one copy of data for all tabs
Do work away from the page so it stays smooth
Pass messages to each open tab
cannot: Keep running after you close every tab of the site
limits.reach_label: Only tabs of the same site
limits.differs: Most computer browsers support it. Chrome on Android and Samsung Internet only partly do.

story.what_it_is: A background script that every tab of a site shares, so one process keeps state across them.

marketing.name: SharedWorker
marketing.pitch: Documents a script that runs in the background and can be used by many tabs of the same site.

story.for_you: You never see it. It is why a chat site can keep one live connection for all your open tabs, saving battery and data.
story.for_makers: It lets one connection or one heavy job serve every tab. Makers save servers and battery. It also means one hidden script can see what all tabs of the site do.

use_cases.example: A web chat opens one live link for all tabs so you do not get duplicate messages.
A browser game that is open in two tabs keeps one network link and one game state.
A web app does one background sync for all open tabs of a document.
A store keeps one live price feed shared across tabs.
A live score or stock page uses one feed shared across tabs.
A site script collects events from every tab in one place.

technical_bounds: Ends when the last page disconnects
Chrome on Android support came late (verify)
